title: Bears DC Dennis Allen: There hasn't been a ton of discussion about signing Cam Jordan

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bears DC Dennis Allen: There hasn't been a ton of discussion about signing Cam Jordan
sources.description: Defensive end Cam Jordan said last month that it would be "phenomenal" if things came together for him to return to the Saints for a 16th season, but that has yet to happen and there haven't been many signs that the status quo in New Orleans is set to change.
